phases.title: D1 — Token lock in the real codebase
phases.goal: Establish apps/desktop/src/tokens.css as Kaydence's sole design-token source (color, type, space, radius, motion, reserved --blue/--gold, per-OS --accent), ported from the gauntlet-locked winner-locked-v1.html. Supersedes the forked per-view token declarations the design audit found in DictateView.css, CleanupView.css, PrivacyView.css, and FirstRunView.css.

gates.title: No view file re-declares a core token

phases.title: D2+D3 — Gauntlet-lite and Claude Design lock (COMPLETE, recorded for audit)
phases.goal: COMPLETE 2026-08-09. Three independent directions (Calm Utility, Editorial Precision, Warm Focus) rendered families 01+07 from one token system, each blind-critiqued against R1-R8 plus competitor cohesion (Wispr Flow, Aqua Voice, Superwhisper, Glaido, native macOS/Windows). Editorial Precision judged the winner — the only candidate clearing all 8 rubric dimensions. Judge fixes and runner-up grafts applied and blind-reverified (all pass; overall 9/10, estimated operator score 9/10). Operator reviewed the locked artifact and accepted at 8.5/10, explicitly waiving the idea.lock's literal >=9 threshold, with two deferred nuances (see hitl.conditions). NOTE: check-design-tokens.sh's --no-view-token-redeclare/--no-hardcoded-hex flags police PRODUCTION view files that must consume an external tokens.css; a standalone single-file HTML reference like the locked winner legitimately defines its own :root token block by design, so those flags do not apply here (an earlier version of P2-G1 misapplied them and always failed). The real R1-R8 evidence for this phase is the recorded gauntlet chain itself: build -> blind critique -> judge -> fix -> blind reverify, documented in docs/design/DESIGN_LANGUAGE_V2_LOCK.md. P2-G1 below is only a minimal structural sanity check that the reference exists with its reserved tokens fenced off.

gates.title: Locked reference exists with reserved tokens fenced

phases.title: D4 — Rebuild the P1 screen families from the lock
phases.goal: Rebuild apps/desktop/src/views/DictateView (01), CleanupView (03), PrivacyView (07), and FirstRunView (10) — plus the shared nav/chrome — to consume tokens.css exclusively and render the locked Editorial Precision system, while preserving every existing React behavior, state hook, and IPC/event contract byte-for-byte. This is a reskin, not a rewrite of app logic. Also resolves the board-vs-invariant nav conflict the audit found by adopting the single 10-item order (Dictate, Whisper-Ahead, Cleanup, Relay, Voiceprint, Conductor, Privacy, Dictionary, Analytics, Setup) as the one NAV constant.

gates.title: Design-token rubric clean on rebuilt views
No regression in existing frontend/backend test suites

phases.title: D5 — Fresh capture and hybridized P1-G4 signoff
phases.goal: Capture Boards 01/03/07/10 plus the First Run permissions modal at the D4 rebuild's closeout SHA, with ADR-0017 model-download rendering gated/off. Independent reviewer compares against the locked winner system (not the old Visual System v1 boards). Operator issues the final hybridized P1-G4 signoff. This is the only step that may flip P1-G4 in ops/mission/state.json.

gates.title: Fresh capture binds to closeout SHA

budget.notes: Soft engineering-time proxy for this sub-mission, not a literal third-party bill — work runs inside the operator's existing session/agent budget. Re-scope if D4's real-codebase rebuild proves larger than the mockup work that preceded it.

conditions: Operator accepted the locked design language at 8.5/10, explicitly waiving idea.lock's literal >=9/10 threshold — recorded honestly as a waiver, not laundered into a passing score.

Known deferred issue: the Cool/Warm palette toggle has no effect in dark mode (winner-locked-v1.html only overrides light-mode neutrals). Fix during D4 or immediately after; not a blocker to proceeding.
Operator flagged unspecified 'other nuances' verbally without itemizing them — surface and log these explicitly during D4 review rather than assuming they are resolved.
D4 must not regress existing React/Tauri behavior. Any gate failure in P3-G3 (test suite) routes back to the build (family G4 in archipelago's protocol-gate routing), not forward.
No push, PR, merge, or ops/mission/state.json gate flip is authorized by this plan alone — P1-G4 remains PENDING until P4 (D5) evidence lands and the operator signs off explicitly.
